name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Billy Doe Meats drove a strong 28-day ROAS of 5.46x on $1,381.29 in Meta spend, generating 41 purchases and $7,538.64 in revenue. The biggest movement this week is a 77.27% surge in ROAS and a 55.56% jump in purchases week-over-week, likely driven by the top campaign "BWS - Sales - Muslims" ($743.39 spend) gaining momentum.

performance.verdict: ROAS surge is real; 7 overdue SOW milestones threaten the engine behind it.

findings.text: 7 SOW milestones overdue by up to 76 days: funnel test, UTM live, subscribe pages, all flows, monthly report, platform audit, pre-launch gate — all unresolved.
ROAS is 5.46x on $1,381.29 spend (28d); 3-day purchase signal (Oct 26–28: 1+0+3 purchases, $1,278.19 revenue) holds vs prior 3 days (Oct 23–25: 1+2+4, $693.88) — efficiency confirmed, not a fluke.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Oct 27–28 and 2 on Oct 26, down from a 28-day average of ~18/day; cause unknown — possible profile suspension or data feed failure.
GA4 sessions spiked to 577 on Oct 25 then fell back to 276 by Oct 28; spend was flat (~$50/day), suggesting a one-day organic or referral pulse — not paid-driven, not sustained.

Meta purchase events fire inconsistently (known Shopify issue); Oct 28 shows $831.64 revenue on only 3 attributed purchases — per-order value ~$277, plausible but unverifiable without Windsor reconciliation.

suggestions.text: Raise BWS - Sales - Muslims daily budget +20%; ROAS 5.46x confirmed over 28 days with purchases rising 55.56% WoW.
suggestions.monday_update: Increase the BWS - Sales - Muslims campaign daily budget by 20% (from ~$47.40/day to ~$57/day). This campaign drove 5.46x ROAS on $1,381.29 spend and purchases are up 55.56% week-over-week — the 3-day window (Oct 26–28) confirms the trend is holding. Success check: ROAS stays at or above 4.0x and purchases do not fall below 1/day over the following 7 days. Re-evaluate by 2026-11-05.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP profile: 0 actions on Oct 27–28 vs 18/day average — confirm no suspension or listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on Oct 27 and Oct 28 after averaging ~18 actions/day across the 28-day window (515 total). Log into Google Business Profile, check for suspensions, policy flags, or a data-feed outage, and restore normal status. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥10/day within 3 days of the fix. Confirm resolution by 2026-11-01.

suggestions.text: Watch 7 overdue SOW milestones — funnel test and UTM gap are the highest attribution risk; no buyer action until milestones clear.
suggestions.monday_update: Seven deliverables are overdue by up to 76 days including the funnel test close, UTM live, subscribe pages, all automation flows, platform ownership audit, pre-launch gate, and monthly report v1. These gaps mean attribution data (especially Meta purchase events and the /halal-subscribe funnel) cannot be trusted for scaling decisions. No additional budget moves are recommended until at minimum the UTM and funnel test milestone are marked complete. Re-check milestone status by 2026-11-05.
